findings.title: Household office and inheritance
findings.claim: The fear of the mawali is sharpened by the requested wali as a household-and-office continuity: the following person is asked to receive inherited substance while also carrying the work of care and management.
findings.mechanism: The household carrier at 19:6:4 contacts the two inheritance forms at 19:6:1-2, while the focus's office, affiliation, and unpriced-gift forms return that transfer through wali and wahb. The reading therefore moves from a generic successor to a successor who can bear a trust across property, knowledge, relationship, and care.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why the request names a wali after fearing plural mawali: the desired answer is a usable human continuity-holder, not merely a biological replacement.
findings.containment: The focus still plainly asks for a wali and the context still says that he will inherit; this does not decide that the inheritance is only material, only scriptural, or only institutional. The household-office synthesis is a macro relation.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence is trusted and supplies the pericope-level anchors, but its nominated source images remain contextual activations rather than new lexical definitions.

findings.title: Gestation as care
findings.claim: The pericope lets the requested gift be perceived as a complete human-care arc: blocked reproductive capacity is answered by prepared life, birth, tenderness, growth, purity, and filial relation.
findings.mechanism: The focus aqr and wahb carriers contact womb, birth, hanan, zakat, and barr/walid relations across 19:2, 19:7, and 19:13-15. Those contacts make the gift more than an arrival: it is a life formed and then ethically held.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to barrenness opens into a sequence of care, so the requested wali is already framed by the conditions that make a person capable of belonging and responsibility.
findings.containment: The reading follows the pericope's human-birth and care imagery; it does not replace the plain statement of barrenness with a purely metaphorical pregnancy or claim that every later virtue is a literal gestational description.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel nomination has direct pericope anchors and exact registered source images, while the cross-ayah life-cycle synthesis remains a contextual reading.

The changed reading is therefore restoration of continuity under several simultaneous closures, not compensation for one defect alone.

findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT-derived relation. It preserves the plain fear, barrenness, and request for a gift; it does not claim that the focus lexically contains hiddenness, weakness, or a guaranteed outcome.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace has supplied coordinates, roles, changed readings, and a focus return, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound; every non-registered branch remains attributed.
